description: This file contains hooks and utility functions for integrating with MkDocs, a static site generator, including functions for resolving files, altering navigation, and handling page markdown, specifically tailored for a multilingual documentation setup using mkdocs-material.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, potentially extended for custom behavior in certain contexts.

methods.name: str get_missing_translation_content(docs_dir: str)
methods.description: Reads the missing-translation.md file from the parent parent directory of the docs directory, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: list[str] get_mkdocs_material_langs()
methods.description: Detects available language templates for mkdocs-material theme components, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: MkDocsConfig on_config(config: MkDocsConfig, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Modifies the MkDocs configuration based on available languages and updates the site URL accordingly.

methods.name: None resolve_file(*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves a filename to an EnFile object, searching in the docs directory and a fallback English source directory.

methods.name: None resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves multiple files specified in various formats (str or dict) into EnFile objects.

methods.name: Files on_files(files: Files, *, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Processes the files in the MkDocs build, resolving theme logos, favicon, CSS, and JS files.

methods.name: list[Union[Page,Section,Link]] generate_renamed_section_items( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )
methods.description: Recursively modifies navigation sections to update titles based on source page titles, affecting how sections are named and collapsed.

methods.name: Navigation on_nav( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Replaces the navigation items with renamed sections as generated by generate_renamed_section_items.

methods.name: Page on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files)
methods.description: A placeholder hook for pre-processing pages; currently returns the page unchanged.

methods.name: str on_page_markdown( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )
methods.description: Augments page markdown and metadata, specifically inserting missing translation notices for certain files.
